description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Water)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Trey], [Apex Freezing Rain Damage Tracker] and [Apex Freezing Rain Level]

description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Water] after using a Fire/Ice/Water ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Trey
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Freezing Rain (0~2), removed after using Apex Freezing Rain two times

description.name: Apex Freezing Rain Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Freezing Rain level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Trey]

description.name: Apex Freezing Rain Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Freezing Rain level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Trey]
